# UDEN — Unified Development & Employment Network

> UDEN (https://uden.tech) is an AI-powered talent assessment, upskilling, and campus recruitment platform bridging the gap between students, job seekers, corporate recruiters, educational institutions, and government skill development missions.

## Core Services & Platform Modules
- **Campus Placement Accelerator**: Enables colleges & TPO officers to host automated placement drives, generate NAAC/NBA analytics, and match students with 150+ corporate recruiters.
- **Pre-Vetted Corporate Talent Finder**: Allows enterprise recruiters to discover candidate profiles mapped to exact technical skill stacks with 48-hour shortlist SLA.
- **Government & State Skill Mission Integration**: GeM-ready, DPIIT-recognized platform for scaling mission-wide student placement tracking across state colleges and skill development centers.
- **AI Skill Gap Analysis & Mock Interview Assistant**: Provides 8-axis technical skill radar evaluations and automated video mock interview feedback.
